request.spec:
A user can watch a person (a toggle on the row, per user; PERSON_WATCHED name=<name>,
PERSON_UNWATCHED name=<name>); show watched yes/no for the signed-in user. When a watched
person's claim is settled, approved or re-settled, one line NOTIFY user=<watcher> person=<name>
number=<number> is written per watching user, in the order they started watching, after the
claim's own line and before the rollup lines.

agent.result_text:
Watching people now works, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**How it works**
- **Storage:** a new migration (`V41__person_watch.sql`) adds a `person_watch` table: one row per sheet, person and user. Each user can watch a person only once. A row's id records the order users started watching. Unwatching deletes the row, so if someone watches again they go to the end of the order.
- **Server:**
  - `person/WatchService.java` handles watching and unwatching and writes `PERSON_WATCHED` / `PERSON_UNWATCHED name=<name>`. Watching someone you already watch, or unwatching someone you don't, is refused with an error and nothing is written.
  - There are three new endpoints on `PersonController`: `GET …/people/watched` (the ids of the people the signed-in user watches), `PUT …/people/{id}/watch` and `DELETE …/people/{id}/watch`.
- **Notifications:** `ClaimService` writes one `NOTIFY user=<watcher> person=<name> number=<number>` line per watcher, in watch order, when a claim is settled, approved or re-settled. The lines go after the claim's own line and before the rollup lines. They are written only if the change commits, like the existing audit lines. Bulk settle goes through the same code, so it notifies too.
  - A clerk's settle that is sent to PENDING instead does not notify.
- **Screen:** each person row has a "Watched" column showing `person-watched` (yes/no for the signed-in user) and a `person-watch` toggle button. A refused toggle shows the row's existing `person-error`, which is cleared when the next action on that row is taken. The watched set is re-read every time the sheet is loaded.

Because the change guard blocks every write from a viewer, viewers can't watch anyone. The request didn't cover viewers, so I left that as it is.
